blockers.description: Real bugs only, each with file:line and why

polish.description: Cosmetic or optional improvements; never block a merge

goodhart.description: Traces of gaming the acceptance: deleted/loosened tests, changed thresholds or expected values, swallowed errors, skipped sections

cannot_verify.description: Requirements that can't be judged from this change alone (they live in untouched code or span parts), and what to check

missing.description: TASK/ACCEPTANCE items from the brief that were not done

extra.description: Unrequested features, options, refactors or files outside the brief
